<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
rows = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
R0,C0=21,12; NR,NC=5,13
def raw(i,j):
    r0,c0=R0+3*i,C0+3*j
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter()
    for dr in range(3):
        for dc in range(3): cnt[rows[r0+dr][c0+dc]]+=1
    return cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
grid=[[raw(i,j) for j in range(NC)] for i in range(NR)]
floor=set('WgNbNR')  # treat red as passable
def isf(r,c): return 0<=r<NR and 0<=c<NC and grid[r][c] in floor
def hop(r,c,dr,dc):
    a=(r+dr,c+dc); b=(r+2*dr,c+2*dc)
    return b if isf(*a) and isf(*b) else None
from collections import deque
start,goal=(4,0),(0,12)
dirs={(-1,0):'UP',(1,0):'DOWN',(0,-1):'LEFT',(0,1):'RIGHT'}
prev={start:None}; q=deque([start])
while q:
    cur=q.popleft()
    for (dr,dc),nm in dirs.items():
        n=hop(*cur,dr,dc)
        if n and n not in prev: prev[n]=(cur,nm); q.append(n)
print("goal reachable?", goal in prev)
cur=goal; seq=[]
while cur!=start:
    p,nm=prev[cur]; seq.append(nm); cur=p
seq.reverse(); print("PATH:", seq, "len", len(seq))
D={'UP':(-1,0),'DOWN':(1,0),'LEFT':(0,-1),'RIGHT':(0,1)}
pos=start
for nm in seq:
    dr,dc=D[nm]; a=(pos[0]+dr,pos[1]+dc); b=(pos[0]+2*dr,pos[1]+2*dc)
    assert isf(*a) and isf(*b),(nm,pos)
    pos=b
print("verify final",pos)
res=action(seq)
print("done:",last_action_result.get('done'),"lc:",last_action_result.get('level_completed'),"go:",last_action_result.get('game_over'))
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color']=='b':
        r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']); c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
        print("player now", (r0-R0)//3,(c0-C0)//3)
print("step",current_frame.step,"level",current_frame.level)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
